name: frontend
overridesComment: postcss: Next 16.2.x pins 8.4.31, vulnerable to GHSA-qx2v-qp2m-jg93 (XSS in CSS stringify, build-time only). Forced to patched 8.5.x — semver-compatible and only used by Next's build, so the static export is unaffected. sharp: Next lists sharp ^0.34.5 as an optional dep for its Image Optimization API; that API never runs here (output:'export' is a static export), so no untrusted image reaches sharp, but the tree still trips npm audit on the inherited libvips CVEs (GHSA-f88m-g3jw-g9cj). Forced to 0.35.x (libvips 8.18.3) to keep audit clean. Node >=20.9 required by sharp 0.35 is satisfied (frontend build image is node:24-alpine).
